structured_output.what_is_happening: The narrative is a "Kardashev Research" meme. It seems to come from a Beff Jezos (@beffjezos, e/acc) tweet that the packet links to (status 2103746282699534606). I could not open that post. At least 10 "Kardashev Research" clones launched within about 2 hours. This one (8Rz6…) is a later clone, created on a Meteora virtual curve and migrated to PumpSwap about 13 minutes before detection. It spiked about 3x to around $400k ATH and was already falling fast at T2 (m5 -27% to -47%). The earliest and largest clone, 5wW9… (about $1.5M mcap, $148k liquidity), is where attention actually sits. This token's own website field points to the 5wW9… page on usepaid.app, so it copied the canonical token's metadata.

narrative.description: The e/acc and Kardashev-scale meme, tied to Beff Jezos (Guillaume Verdon), whose bio references Kardashev scaling. A "Kardashev Research" tweet appears to have started a wave of clone launches.
narrative.why_spreading: Beff Jezos has a large following, and a tweet mentioning something like Kardashev Research set off a launch race across many clones. Attention is split between them and goes mostly to the $1.5M canonical token.

token_connection.why_this_token: None found, apart from the same name and a copied tweet link. Its website field points to another token's (5wW9…) page, so it is a copycat.
token_connection.competing_tokens: 5wW9mhbwq1… ($1.53M mcap, $148k liquidity, earliest) looks canonical. Gff9… ($6.7M h1 volume), plus AAye…, ET1W… and BeWE… are other clones, several already drained to near-zero liquidity.

authenticity.evidence: 640 unique buyers against only 59 unique sellers, with about 3,400 transactions in 13 minutes. GMGN tags 21 bundler wallets. One unlabeled wallet holds 80% of supply. Two sibling clones (AAye…, ET1W…) already have under $100 of liquidity after multi-million-dollar volume, which fits a serial clone-and-pull pattern.
authenticity.uncertainty: The 80% wallet might be a Meteora curve or pool vault that RugCheck does not label. I could not see X posts about this contract.

structural_risks: One unlabeled wallet holds 80% of supply
RugCheck: 100% of LP unlocked, few LP providers
Copycat of a larger canonical token
Sibling clones already drained of liquidity
Already down 27-47% from ATH within 5 minutes

structured_output.counterargument: The Beff Jezos narrative is real and fresh, and 640 unique buyers is genuine traffic. If the 80% wallet is just a Meteora pool vault, this coin could bounce hard in the clone war when the canonical token pumps, and a 2x from a dumped level on $43k liquidity is not impossible.

structured_output.thesis: This is a late copycat clone of a Beff Jezos-inspired meme, and the canonical token (5wW9…) is 8x larger. Its own metadata links to that other token. It has already dumped from its ATH, one unlabeled wallet holds 80%, sibling clones have been drained, and the LP flags conflict. The chance of a runner is low and the rug risk is high.
